items.summary: Police have seized 96 stolen vehicles that were destined to be shipped to West Africa and have charged a dozen people in connection with a multi-jurisdictional, transnational auto theft investigation with links to the Greater Toronto Area.

items.title: Police seek witnesses, video after driver killed by fallen tree in Surrey, B.C.
items.summary: Police are appealing for witnesses to come forward after a driver was killed by a tree that fell on a car during a powerful windstorm earlier this month in Surrey, B.C.

items.title: Rules, Procedures and the Rights of Parliament – November 17, 2026
Pedestrian struck by vehicle in Richmond Hill
items.summary: A pedestrian has been struck by a vehicle in Richmond Hill on Monday afternoon. York police say the collision occurred in the area of Bayview and 16th avenues just after 2:30 p.m. The severity of the pedestrian’s injuries are unknown at this point, but they were taken to hospital by trauma run.
